product_one_liner.value: Matillion provides AI-powered data integration and pipeline automation that helps enterprise data teams move, transform, and manage data for analytics and AI.
product_one_liner.notes: Company descriptions identify data teams and enterprises as its users.

pricing_page.notes: Public page describes plans and consumption-based pricing, though it does not list monetary prices.

named_customers.notes: Both have individual Matillion customer success stories.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn reports a 201–500 employee company size.

hq_location.notes: Matillion describes itself as having dual headquarters in Denver and Manchester.

founded_year.notes: Matillion states it was founded in 2011.

eng_blog.notes: The company blog index is primarily product, marketing, and data-practice content; it does not establish two engineer-authored posts specifically about how Matillion's product is built.

public_docs.notes: Both public documentation portals contain multiple product articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live listings include Senior Staff AI Engineer and Computer Science Industrial Placement – Software Engineering with AI.

model_provider.value: AWS Bedrock, OpenAI ChatGPT, and OpenAI for Azure
model_provider.notes: Matillion's AI FAQ says its AI Prompt components integrate with these third-party AI services; customers may also use their own provider API keys.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center names these certifications or compliance standards.

last_funding.notes: Tracxn lists a Nov.  8, 2022 Series E round as undisclosed; amount_usd is 0 as a placeholder because the round amount was not disclosed, not because the company raised zero.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest listed round is dated November 2022, outside the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live openings include Sales Development Representative, Senior Sales Development Representative, and multiple Enterprise Account Executive roles.

launched_6mo.notes: The latest launch-type item located was Maia's Migration Agent public preview, announced March 26, 2026—before the May 9, 2026 start of the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Matillion announced Girish Pancha's appointment as CEO on August 4, 2026, and Tim O'Neil's appointment as CRO in March 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable careers listings and public docs reviewed did not identify CRM or sales/marketing systems Matillion itself uses; product connector support is not evidence of internal use.
